title: Just paid for the gym
hook: Should elapsed time since payment affect the value of the next visit?

knows: basic arithmetic and reading a small table
doesNotKnow: Separate payment timing from the marginal physical benefit of attendance.

misconception: The quantities in this case can be combined without checking their reference, denominator, or information boundary.
objective: Separate payment timing from the marginal physical benefit of attendance.
keyState: Both complete computed cases are visible as retained observations; the question-case picture survives Reset.

claims.text: A toy membership has already cost €60. The next visit costs €0 and brings eight benefit units. What new cash cost does attending add? Toy inputs A=[60, 0, 8]; B=[0, 10, 8].
claims.source: Local explicit hypothetical assumptions in spec.ts and model.ts; not participant measurements.

claims.text: Computed results: [[60, 0, 8], [0, 10, -2]]. Labels: Sunk €, Marginal €, Net next.
claims.source: compute() in the lesson-local model.ts; finite numeric operations over the explicit inputs.

claims.text: Already-paid membership fees and the cost of the next visit are different quantities. The alternative case charges for each new visit. Payment timing can influence behavior, but sunk expenditure does not become a new marginal cash cost.
claims.source: The two controlled cases in spec.ts; scope limited to these toy inputs and displayed model rule.

claims.text: A new toy case uses Already paid €=0, Next visit €=10, Benefit units=8. What is Marginal €? Answer: 10.
claims.source: compute() applied to the contrasting new input case; source list is an idea pointer only.

recall.question: A new toy case uses Already paid €=0, Next visit €=10, Benefit units=8. What is Marginal €?
recall.why: Applying the stated toy rule to the new inputs gives 10. The result depends on these assumptions; it is not a universal behavioral response.

sourceProvenance.text: Gym attendance peaks just after a payment and fades until the next one (Gourville & Soman, 1998).
sourceProvenance.caveat: Original list says figures are approximate and papers were not individually rechecked. No empirical source is verified by this build.

meaningfulDifference: Separate payment timing from the marginal physical benefit of attendance.
